contract_agreement_summary: Miltenyi Biotec will supply products to Bellicum Pharmaceuticals.
Bellicum will pay Miltenyi a non-refundable upfront fee of €2,000,000 in installments.
Bellicum will pay Miltenyi milestone payments for each Bellicum Product.
Bellicum will reimburse Miltenyi for Third Party royalties and/or license fees under specific conditions.
Agreement outlines terms for confidentiality, disclosure, and publicity.
